name: Freestyle MX
author: Local vehicle SDK example
description:
Freestyle motocross. Left stick is the BIKE, right stick is the RIDER.

RIDE    Left stick steers. RT throttle, LT front brake, B rear brake.
        A is the clutch: hold it, rev, and dump it to loft the front.
PRELOAD Pull the left stick BACK on the face of a jump and snap it forward
        at the lip. That, not your run-up speed, is your jump height.
WHEELIE Left stick back on the throttle. Forward on the front brake stoppies.
AIR     Bars whip the back end round; left stick held is a flip; right stick
        rolls for a tabletop. LET GO and the bike squares itself to land.
TRICKS  Hold LB or RB and push the right stick. Tuck back in before you land.

Y or E gets on and off, R or R3 resets, F9 respawns the bike nearby.
Keyboard: WASD ride, arrows bike attitude, IJKL rider, Z/X tricks, C clutch.

speed.label: Maximum speed (m/s)
speed.description: Applied live. A 250 four-stroke tops out around 30.

tire_friction.label: Tire friction coefficient
tire_friction.description: Knobbies on dirt. Lower slides more.

lean_max.label: Maximum lean (radians)
lean_max.description: How far the bike lays over. Past atan(tire friction) the tyres cannot hold it and it just scrubs speed.

lean_rate.label: Lean response
lean_rate.description: How quickly the lean takes up. Lower is more gradual and easier to adjust mid-corner.

lean_expo.label: Steering softness near centre
lean_expo.description: Softens the first part of the stick so small corrections are possible. 0 is linear; 0.6 means a quarter stick asks for about a tenth of the lean.

counter_steer.label: Steering to lean
counter_steer.description: How much bar input becomes lean at speed. Zero means the right stick alone leans it.

lean_yaw.label: Cornering bite
lean_yaw.description: How hard the bike follows the arc its lean angle dictates. Lower understeers and slides wide.

steer_rate.label: Turn rate
steer_rate.description: How hard the bars turn the bike at speed. Lean physics alone caps out around half this once you are moving.

grip_assist.label: Grip assist
grip_assist.description: How much of the turn is made by pointing the bike rather than by the tyres. High feels railed; low feels loose and slides more.

berm_assist.label: Berm bite
berm_assist.description: How much a banked corner adds to your lean. Most of a berm already works without this; past about 0.45 the tyres give up and the bike slides wide instead of turning harder.

step_assist.label: Step climbing
step_assist.description: Tallest kerb or stair riser the bike will climb, in metres. A raycast wheel cannot roll over an edge on its own, so without this the bike stops dead on anything above about a 0.15 m step. Ramps are unaffected. 0 turns it off.

preload_release.label: Preload pop
preload_release.description: Launch impulse from loading the suspension and releasing it on a lip.

air_yaw.label: Whip authority
air_yaw.description: How hard the bars swing the back end round in the air.

whip_rate.label: Whip rate (rad/s)
whip_rate.description: How far round the bars will send the back end at full lock in the air.

flip_rate.label: Flip rate (rad/s)
flip_rate.description: Pitch rate on a held stick. A backflip takes about 2*pi divided by this, in seconds.

hud.label: Show the HUD
hud.description: Controls, speed, score and the current trick.

scoring.label: Score runs
scoring.description: Award points for air time, rotation and tricks held and tucked in.

remount.label: Get back on automatically
remount.description: After a crash, stand the bike up and put the rider back on it. Turn this off to walk back yourself.
